issues.description: Element: the column selected for the swimming-pool name in task 'Aufgabe 03'. The problem statement (problem_statement.md) requests "Namen und Art aller Schwimmbäder" (the name and type of each Schwimmbad). The reference solution (solution_repository/aufgabe03.sql) selects Schwimmbad.id as the first column (SELECT Schwimmbad.id, Schwimmbad.art ...), i.e. the pool id instead of the pool name. This mismatch between the required column (name) and the provided solution column (id) will confuse students about which column to return and will cause automated validators expecting the name to mark correct student answers as wrong.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the solution query to return the pool name instead of the id so it matches the problem text. For example: SELECT Schwimmbad.name, Schwimmbad.art AS Art, Gemeinde.name, Gemeinde.einwohner_m, Gemeinde.einwohner_w FROM Schwimmbad, Gemeinde WHERE Gemeinde.schluessel = Schwimmbad.gemeindeschluessel. Alternatively, if the solution intentionally should return the id, update the problem statement to explicitly request the id.
